result: Invoke handlers + lifecycle events: PtyInvokeCommand exposes ONLY typed PTY operations (attach/input/resize/interrupt/detach/close/restart/resync) with no free-form command strings; PtyInvokeResult returns typed acks/events; the handler holds an Arc<PtyRegistry> so registry lifecycle is app-managed and outlives views. Unknown attachments fail closed; detach and close are distinct lifecycle events.
